words.definition: overcrowding that causes a blockage, such as in traffic
words.example: Traffic congestion during rush hour adds twenty minutes to the commute.
words.exampleTranslation: 尖峰時段的交通壅塞讓通勤多花二十分鐘。

words.definition: a statement or situation that is opposed to another
words.example: There is a contradiction between the two reports on quarterly earnings.
words.exampleTranslation: 這兩份關於季度盈餘的報告之間存在矛盾。

words.definition: opposite in nature or direction
words.example: Contrary to expectations, the new product sold out within a week.
words.exampleTranslation: 跟預期相反，這項新產品一週內就賣完了。

words.definition: a certificate awarded for completing a course of study
words.example: She proudly displayed her diploma on the office wall.
words.exampleTranslation: 她驕傲地把畢業證書掛在辦公室牆上。

words.definition: a company or person that supplies goods to retailers
words.example: The company signed a new distributor to expand into overseas markets.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家公司簽了一位新的經銷商以拓展海外市場。

words.definition: to plunge into water headfirst, or to drop sharply
words.example: Stock prices took a dive after the disappointing earnings report.
words.exampleTranslation: 令人失望的財報公布後，股價驟然下跌。

words.definition: having or showing a lot of energy
words.example: The new intern is energetic and eager to learn.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位新來的實習生精力充沛且渴望學習。

words.definition: in a way relating to the natural environment
words.example: The factory switched to environmentally friendly packaging last year.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家工廠去年改用對環境友善的包裝。

words.definition: a moving staircase
words.example: Take the escalator to the second floor for the electronics department.
words.exampleTranslation: 搭電扶梯到二樓就是電子產品部門。

words.definition: unusual or foreign in an interesting way
words.example: The restaurant menu features exotic spices from Southeast Asia.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間餐廳的菜單有來自東南亞的異國香料。

words.definition: cloth material
words.example: The tailor selected a durable fabric for the winter coats.
words.exampleTranslation: 裁縫師為冬季外套挑選了耐用的布料。

words.definition: a broad statement based on limited specifics
words.example: Avoid making generalizations about customer preferences without data.
words.exampleTranslation: 沒有數據支持時，避免對顧客偏好做概括性的論斷。

words.definition: advice or direction given to someone
words.example: New employees receive guidance from a mentor during their first month.
words.exampleTranslation: 新進員工在第一個月會有導師提供指導。

words.definition: a soft, sweet substance chewed for flavor, or a sticky plant sap
words.example: Chewing gum is not allowed during client presentations.
words.exampleTranslation: 客戶簡報期間不可以嚼口香糖。

words.definition: slow to act or speak because of uncertainty
words.example: The board was hesitant to approve the merger without more data.
words.exampleTranslation: 董事會在沒有更多資料前對核准合併感到猶豫。

words.definition: a sign or measure that shows a trend or condition
words.example: Rising sales are a strong indicator of market recovery.
words.exampleTranslation: 銷售上升是市場復甦的強烈指標。

words.definition: separately, one at a time
words.example: Each item will be inspected individually before shipping.
words.exampleTranslation: 每件商品出貨前都會個別檢查。

words.definition: lower in rank or younger/less experienced
words.example: She was recently promoted from a junior to a senior analyst position.
words.exampleTranslation: 她最近從資淺分析師晉升為資深分析師。

words.definition: the way a person or group lives
words.example: The brand targets consumers with an active, health-conscious lifestyle.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個品牌鎖定生活方式積極且注重健康的消費者。

words.definition: the confidence, enthusiasm, and discipline of a group
words.example: Team morale improved after the company announced the bonus program.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司宣布獎金方案後，團隊士氣提升了。
